pages.text: Pierce yourself with a $(item)Lucky Arrow$() while you have a Stand, and it sheds its look for another.

$(warn)A skin you only wear is lost when you switch away.$() To keep one, use a $(item)Memory Disc$() while your Stand wears it, then play the disc.$(br2)Kept skins can be worn again from the $(bold)Skins$() page of your menu.
